coding_conventions.build_tool: Maven with Spring Boot 3.3.5 for backend; npm scripts with Vite for frontend
coding_conventions.package_structure: Backend feature packages are under backend/src/main/java/kr/ac/knue/commonfoundation/{feature}; frontend routes are under frontend/src/app/router.tsx and pages under frontend/src/pages/{area}
coding_conventions.dto_style: Java request/response DTOs use records; observed LoginRequest is a validated record (backend/src/main/java/kr/ac/knue/commonfoundation/auth/LoginRequest.java:5-8). No scope-specific DTOs can be identified without staged tasks.
coding_conventions.service_style: Constructor-injected Spring @Service classes; 85 *Service.java files found under backend/src/main/java, including AuthService (backend/src/main/java/kr/ac/knue/commonfoundation/auth/AuthService.java:8-18).
coding_conventions.persistence_style: MyBatis XML mapper is dominant: 76 XML mapper files versus 5 Java mapper files containing @Select annotations. Follow XML mappers unless a staged specification explicitly requires annotation SQL.
coding_conventions.controller_response_style: Spring @RestController methods wrap results in ApiResponse; AuthController uses ApiResponse.ok and ApiResponse.empty (backend/src/main/java/kr/ac/knue/commonfoundation/auth/AuthController.java:24-60).

conventions.primary_key: Existing tables use bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY for numeric entities; code/value tables also use natural primary keys.
conventions.fk_column_pattern: Referenced numeric keys use a singular entity name plus _id, such as user_id and menu_id; organization references use organization_code.
conventions.soft_delete_pattern: status varchar(20) commonly allows DELETED; no deleted_at convention was observed.
